text: Authorized staff publish CLOSED or REOPENED notices with valid building/time fields and stable event IDs.
criteria: Unauthorized publication and missing building/time are rejected; replay of a valid publish retains its event identity.

text: Route each accepted notice independently to the feed and delivery consumers. Failure of one does not erase the other's work.
criteria: Fail the delivery consumer; the operations feed still records EV-001 once.

text: Send only to enabled building subscribers at the final eligibility check; a later preference change cannot retract an already accepted delivery.
criteria: For EV-001 only student-1 is initially eligible; disable before the final check in a controlled test and observe SKIPPED.

text: Redelivery of an event or retry after simulator acceptance creates no duplicate simulator effect.
criteria: Timeout after simulator acceptance, then replay; one provider record/reference exists for the delivery key.

text: Retain failed notices for authorized replay and expose pending/accepted/failed/skipped states.
criteria: Exhaust retries for one recipient, authorize replay after recovery and inspect a coherent delivery history.

text: For 100 recipients and 10 events, eligible deliveries become accepted within 30 seconds under nominal simulator responses.
criteria: Execute 100-recipient/10-event workload and verify every eligible delivery and elapsed time.
